subject.title: OAuth 401 regression: oauth-2025-04-20 beta not injected when context1m set via model headers

question: Should maintainers adopt and retarget the open fork PR, or close it and sponsor a same-repository fix for the current Anthropic header-composition path?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the visible closing PR is outside the main repository and targets older files, so automation should not create a competing fix until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Sponsor current-main fix
options.body: Create or approve a focused same-repository patch in the active Anthropic transport/header composition with regression tests for direct OAuth plus model-level beta headers.

options.title: Adopt and retarget fork PR
options.body: Bring the fork work into the main repository, change it to cover the current transport/plugin path, and require focused proof before merge.

options.title: Wait on fork update
options.body: Leave this issue open until the fork author updates the branch into a viable current-main landing path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor current-main fix
recommendation.body: Create or approve a focused same-repository patch in the active Anthropic transport/header composition with regression tests for direct OAuth plus model-level beta headers.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent provider-header history point most directly to this area for choosing the landing path.
